config.medsystem.option.enableHitDebug.c: Debug renderer for last hit information
config.medsystem.option.forceEntityRotat: Forces player rotation synchronization between server and clients
config.medsystem.option.defaultEntityHit: Expands entity hitbox for projectile detection purposes by this amount in all directions
config.medsystem.option.useExplosionPerf: Uses less hit traces for explosions to save performance
config.medsystem.option.armorSystem.comm: Defines armor calculation logic with custom health system
SIMULATED - modular armor with fully simulated logic such as deflections, blunt damage and so on
MODULAR - modular armor - getting hit in head damages only helmet
MODULAR_BOOSTED - same as above, but each armor piece has 150% additional protection
VANILLA - vanilla armor calculation, full armor is used for any damage calculations
config.medsystem.option.prioritizeVitalH: Health will be primarily recovered into vital parts
config.medsystem.option.allowThirdPartyE: Allows interactions (such as healing) with other entities
config.medsystem.option.vitalBodyPartHea: Threshold for prioritized vital limb health recovery
config.medsystem.option.allowInjuryRecov: Allows scaling of injury recovery status effects when getting the effect repeatedly
config.medsystem.option.useBloodSystem.c: Enables blood system simulation, unconscious entity state
config.medsystem.option.showBloodLevel.c: Enables blood level display in health UI
config.medsystem.option.bleedOutUnconsci: Defines handling of unconscious bleed out stage when the affected player has too low blood level to wake up on their own
When disabled, bleed out damage will be applied immediately after losing ability to wake up
config.medsystem.option.unconsciousOnDea: Chance specifying if you can enter unconscious state instead of dying so that you may be rescued by your friends
config.medsystem.option.unconsciousOnHea: Unconscious on head limb death chance
Will prevent entering unconscious state on death if your head limb is dead too
config.medsystem.option.rescueWaitDurati: Rescue waiting period before dying while in death unconscious state
config.medsystem.option.unconsciousOnBlo: Unconscious time due to blood loss
Unconscious duration interval on unconsciousness due to blood loss
config.medsystem.option.unconsciousHeldI: Chance that you will drop held equipment from both hands upon entering unconscious state
config.medsystem.option.unconsciousSound: Sound volume scaling when unconscious. Set to 0 to disable all sounds from being played
config.medsystem.option.enableStatusEffe: Enables hit effects such as bleeds, fractures and other effects
config.medsystem.option.bleedChance.comm: Base chance for getting any type of bleed from '#medsystem:bleed_causing' damage type
config.medsystem.option.bleedDuration.co: Default duration of bleeding status effect
config.medsystem.option.sharpToolBleedMu: Bleed chance multiplier for items from '#medsystem:sharp_tools' tag - swords, spears, axes
config.medsystem.option.fractureChance.c: Base chance for getting fracture from '#medsystem:fracture_causing' damage type
config.medsystem.option.fractureDuration: Default duration of fracture status effect
config.medsystem.option.bluntToolFractur: Fracture chance multiplier for items from '#medsystem:blunt_tools' tag - shovels, pickaxes, hoes and mace
config.medsystem.option.forceBloodDecalC: Forces all blood decals to be have specific color - configure in the option below
config.medsystem.option.bloodDecalFadeOu: Lifetime percentage at which decals will start to fade out
config.medsystem.option.heavyBleedDecalC: How many decals will be spawned by each heavy bleed tick
config.medsystem.option.lightBleedDecalC: How many decals will be spawned by each light bleed tick
config.medsystem.option.damageDecalScale: How much damage entity needs to receive in order for decal to appear
config.medsystem.option.maxDamageDecalsP: Maximum amount of decals which can appear when damaging entities
Set to 0 to disable damage decals
config.medsystem.option.damageMotionScal: How much motion is applied to decals on received damage
config.medsystem.option.projectileDamage: How much motion is applied to decals on received damage from projectiles
config.medsystem-client.option.colorSche: Color schema used for color blending of limb overlay based on the part health
config.medsystem-client.option.renderHea: Allows you to toggle default health HUD overlay
config.medsystem-client.option.horizonta: Set horizontal alignment for the overlay
config.medsystem-client.option.verticalA: Set vertical alignment for the overlay
config.medsystem-client.option.x.comment: Set x axis offset for the overlay
config.medsystem-client.option.y.comment: Set y axis offset for the overlay
config.medsystem-client.option.healthDis: Set limb health detail render mode
